scope: Complete prompts and curation of 21 generation/edit rounds recorded in six source logs, including dedicated FLOW, GLASS and STONE portraits produced after real mobile browser QA. The 22 delivered WebP files exclude rejected images, superseded mobile variants and all source PNGs. Records are grouped by source log, not a timed execution transcript.
pathConvention: Every deliveredFiles/artifacts.path value is relative to the MAGMA project root. Raw PNGs, rejected images and working copies are omitted. Temporary absolute paths are replaced by generation record IDs. supersededArtifacts.formerDeliveryPath is a reused historical path, not a link to an included old file.
artisticInterpretation: All imagery is AI-generated artwork. Words such as photograph, photographic, physically real and geological truth in the preserved prompts describe visual intentions, not documentary provenance or scientific validation. Prompt percentages, coordinates and ideal sizes are creative requests, not measured material data or guaranteed output dimensions.

processing.desktop: Nine selected native 1672 x 941 material plates; no artificial upscaling.
processing.portraitMobile: Five dedicated portrait plates: PRESSURE, FLOW, GLASS and SEALED are 853 x 1844; STONE is native 830 x 1896.
processing.otherMobile: Four retained mobile variants (MOLTEN, SKIN, CRACK and FRACTURE) are 960 x 540 downsampled desktop plates.
processing.concepts: Four selected full-frame concept references in docs/concepts; three landscape and one portrait.
processing.generationResolutionNote: Several prompts requested 2560 x 1440 or higher. Actual native output dimensions, verified against image files, are recorded per round and artifact.
processing.mobileQaRefinement: FLOW, GLASS and STONE were recomposed through image-generation edits after real mobile QA. Their final WebP conversion used sharp quality 91, effort 6 at native dimensions. The previous three 960 x 540 variants are recorded as superseded and not included.

promptMetadata.payload: Complete prompt of the selected or repurposed generation round identified by each artifact.generationRecordId.
promptMetadata.pixelHashMethod: SHA-256 of Pillow-decoded RGB bytes at native dimensions; before/after provenance-pass values match for all 22 images. These are image-integrity checks, not thermal measurements.
promptMetadata.storage: A same-name .webp.json provenance sidecar accompanies each of the 22 delivered WebP raster files. Full prompts and curation are also collected in this manifest.
promptMetadata.tool: Impeccable embed-prompt; its WebP path writes a JSON sidecar rather than an embedded RIFF/XMP/EXIF chunk.
promptMetadata.verification: All 22 sidecar prompts match the corresponding generation-round strings exactly. All sidecar bytes and SHA-256 hashes are recorded per artifact.

hot-assets.sourceNote: AI-generated photographic material assets; no third-party source imagery was supplied for these images. The crack v2 edit used the generated crack v1 as its only reference.
hot-assets.resolutionNote: Requested 16:9 at 2560x1440 or higher in prompts. Actual native tool output is 1672x941 for every image; no artificial upscaling was performed.

mobile-assets.sourceNote: Production images edited from the project's AI-generated mobile UI concept. No third-party photography. All outputs preserve the native 853x1844 canvas with no resizing or post-generation repainting.

mobile-refinement-hot.sourceNote: Both source material images belong to the project's AI-generated visual series. Outputs were recomposed as portrait assets by image generation, not cropped, rotated, resized, or manually repainted.
mobile-refinement-hot.qaScope: Real mobile FLOW and GLASS browser screenshots were examined for composition; screenshots are not included as assets.
mobile-refinement-hot.pixelInspectionNote: The retained numerical negative-space inspections measure image pixel values only, not physical material data.

mobile-refinement-stone.reason: Real mobile QA showed that the desktop-derived STONE crop placed bright, detailed basalt directly behind the heading and body copy.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: dedicated portrait mobile material background for chapter CRYSTAL / STONE of MAGMA — Stone Before Stone. Output a VERTICAL 9:19.5 image, ideally the native 853 x 1844 portrait canvas. Input image: the supplied original AI-generated black basalt macro photograph is the material and visual reference. Preserve its material identity: very dark dense granular basalt, hard irregular fractured faces, fine crystalline grain, sparse tiny natural muted olive-green olivine inclusions and dark pyroxene facets, a few irregular pores. Preserve its severe cool neutral lighting and photographic geological realism. Recompose only the camera/framing and empty space for mobile.
Composition: the upper 7 percent is uninterrupted nearly pure black for a header. From y=15 to 42 percent, the left 85 percent of the portrait must be quiet near-black negative space without bright texture, rock, inclusions, lines or details. This is deliberately clear space for later HTML typography; DO NOT render any text. The actual huge rock face should dominate the LOWER half, mainly y=55 to 95 percent and extending beyond the bottom and both side edges. Its upper boundary rises gently from the lower-left at about y=65 percent toward the right at about y=49 percent, making a monumental heavy diagonal slope. Only a very subtle far-right dark shoulder may approach y=45 percent. Keep the whole y=15–42 percent text zone empty black. This must still feel like an extreme close material face, not a small isolated stone or a rock placed on a plinth.
Material: use the same convincing hard, compact fine-grained volcanic groundmass with tactile irregular facets as the reference. A few very small embedded olive-green crystals can catch low neutral grazing light in the lower rock area, but must remain subordinate to the black basalt. Fine ash-grey glints reveal local edges and grain without turning the rock pale. Good close-up texture and depth; no soft rubber, no smoothly melted glass, no repeating texture, no giant crystal clusters.
Strict exclusions: no typography, symbols, numerals, labels, UI or borders anywhere; no glowing cracks, orange, red heat, embers, neon, particles or smoke; no hexagonal columns, pillars, quartz/amethyst, jewelry, gemstones as hero objects, metal, isolated floating rock, volcanic landscape or horizon. The result is a dark, weighty, cold crystalline-stone material plate with clear upper negative space and rich lower-half detail.
generationRounds.evaluation: Selected after direct original-size visual inspection against the original STONE material and real mobile QA. The top is nearly pure black; the left title and body-copy zone through roughly 42% height is clear. A large granular basalt slope occupies the lower half, rising toward the right without entering the main upper-left copy zone. Hard irregular mineral grain, dark pores and a few muted olive-green inclusions preserve the original material identity. No lettering, interface, glow, columns, jewelry or added atmospheric effects. Actual native aspect ratio is slightly narrower than the requested ideal, but the dedicated negative-space composition meets the mobile layout intent. No further refinement was necessary for composition.
